scenes.title: x02
lines: Switching to a reflection diagnostic changes how the same surfaces appear. Distinguish the final game view from a diagnostic view.

scenes.title: x14
lines: In this example, the seams between wall pieces stand out. Check whether stored lighting joins smoothly across neighboring surfaces. The visible seam alone does not establish a single cause.

scenes.title: x29
lines: As the camera turns into the room, walls and spatial points appear together. Distinguish the lighting image attached to a wall from lighting information sampled in space. The points are not light-emitting bulbs.

scenes.title: xsh
lines: Disabling a light differs from disabling shadows. Removing the whole light contribution first darkens the terrain. After restoring it, shadow settings are changed. Distinguish shading caused by surface orientation from shadows cast when another surface blocks light.

scenes.title: x37
lines: After the nearby region, inspect distant terrain too. These settings control distant shadow coverage and cascade count. Read the settings together with the region of the view they cover.

scenes.title: x36
lines: Pulling the camera back reveals the spatial separation between the nearby objects and distant terrain.
